title: cryptandra humilis
intro: Cryptandra humilis, commonly known as the Low Cryptandra, is a small, flowering shrub native to Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Cryptandra humilis include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and antifungal properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, particularly hydrolysable tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
